families.title: Crypto intraday session predictability

source.summary: The cited research documents smooth intraday seasonality and time-varying short-horizon predictability in Bitcoin; AlphaPilot treats it as a falsifiable hypothesis rather than a guaranteed anomaly.
source.citation: Baur and Dimpfl, Bitcoin at High Frequency, 2019 working paper. Supporting periodicity context: Petukhina et al., arXiv:2109.12142.

families.mechanism: Broad UTC sessions may retain a short-lived conditional return sign because liquidity and participation vary systematically through the day.
families.formula: sign(rolling mean of prior completed returns for the same frozen UTC session), entered at the next session open

universe.selection: frozen BTC, ETH and SOL Development panel

adaptationLimits: one lagged liquidity and volatility gate at most

families.title: Hedged crypto funding carry

source.summary: The cited work formalizes perpetual-futures pricing and funding; AlphaPilot requires aligned same-exchange spot, perpetual, funding and dual-leg execution evidence before testing a carry strategy.
source.citation: Ackerer, Hugonnier and Jermann, Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures, 2022.

families.mechanism: A delta-hedged spot-perpetual position may collect funding when carry exceeds basis risk and dual-leg costs.
families.formula: funding income minus spot-perpetual basis change, fees, slippage and capacity costs

parameters.alignment: same exchange and point in time

universe.instrumentType: same-exchange spot and USDT perpetual pairs
universe.selection: blocked until PIT aligned universe exists
